title: Omani forces take Fort Jesus from the Portuguese
summary: After a siege of nearly three years, Omani Arabs stormed Fort Jesus at Mombasa, the main Portuguese stronghold on the Swahili coast.
reason: The Sultanate of Oman sought to drive the Portuguese from East Africa and take over the Indian Ocean trade.
significance: It ended Portuguese power north of Mozambique and began Omani dominance on the East African coast.
